pages.title: Closeness & Distance
pages.text: $(bold)Bond$(): High Trust and low Fear; she feels especially close to her master.$(br2)$(bold)Friendly$(): Relatively high Trust and low Fear.$(br2)$(bold)Stranger$(): Low Trust without strong Fear; the relationship feels distant.

pages.title: Fear & Conflict
pages.text: $(bold)Fearful$(): Fear has become noticeably high.$(br2)$(bold)Terrified$(): Low Trust and high Fear.$(br2)$(bold)Conflicted$(): Trust and Fear are both high.$(br2)$(bold)Neutral$(): No stronger relationship pattern currently applies.
